import numpy as np
def forward(X,Ws,bs):
    A=X; shapes=[]
    for i,(W,b) in enumerate(zip(Ws,bs)):
        Z=A@W+b
        A=np.maximum(0,Z) if i<len(Ws)-1 else 1/(1+np.exp(-Z))
        shapes.append(A.shape)
    return A,shapes
out,shapes=forward(X,Ws,bs)
out_shape=out.shape;p_mean=round(float(out.mean()),3)
try:
    forward(X,Ws[::-1],bs[::-1])
except Exception as e:
    err_type=type(e).__name__
expect: Q1 решить shapes. Q2 опора: формула и заготовка этого урока. Q3 (100,16),(100,8),(100,1), обратный порядок ValueError.
